name: avatar-group
description: Avatar groups display a collection of avatars representing people or entities.

documentBlocks.content: Avatar groups display a collection of avatars representing people or entities.

Keyboard focus.

Individual avatars inside Avatar group can be navigated using a keyboard. The keyboard focus state adds a focus ring around the avatar.

Adjusting stroke color to match neutral backgrounds.

Each individual avatar has a stroke applied to better show distinction between individual users in the group. By default, the outline color is a neutral gray, but the stroke color should be adjusted manually to match the background where the avatar group is placed.
Do not adjust stroke color on a colored background
documentBlocks.dont: When using a colored background the avatar stroke color should remain set as default for both light and dark themes.

label.description: Optional text label displayed with the avatar group (e.g., group name).

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Row holding the overlapping avatars and the optional label. It is the root.

anatomy.name: avatars
anatomy.description: Overlapping stack of avatars. It hosts the default slot; each avatar is one fill, drawn overlapping the previous one.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Text label next to the stack, such as the member count; optional via the label option.

anatomyReview.notes: Figma S2 Web avatar group page (all 7 size variants: a frame named Stack holding the Avatar instances, plus a Label, which matches the avatars host) and React Spectrum S2 AvatarGroup. The repeated avatars sit in one host part, avatars (A142); the avatar is what the default slot accepts, so avatar is no longer a part. An explicit container is the root. The avatar to avatar and avatar group to label spacings are now spacings between these parts.
